documented_claim: install.sh downloads the payload named in the platform manifest, computes SHA-512 and aborts ('Security Halt') if it differs from the manifest value.
observed_method: observe: run install.sh in a disposable container behind the egress proxy; record hosts (antigravity.google, *.run.app manifest host, storage.googleapis.com) and confirm the halt path by serving a mismatched manifest from a local mirror (container DNS override; no vendor traffic altered)
notes: surface=CLI (antigravity-cli); pre_login_checkable=yes. Integrity only: hash and payload come from the same publisher chain; no signature or pinning.

documented_claim: The installer's `agy install` step edits shell profiles (PATH and legacy agy/antigravity aliases) unless --skip-path / --skip-aliases is given.
observed_method: observe: filesystem watch on ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.profile, ~/.config/fish during install with and without the flags
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. install.sh itself only accepts -d/--dir; the flags must be consumed by `agy install` (to verify).

documented_claim: The CLI self-updates in the background with a 15-minute debounce marker (last_check.timestamp) and advisory lock (update.lock) in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/updater/.
observed_method: observe: first run of `agy --version` and an unauthenticated `agy -p hi`; record updater hosts and files created under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/updater/ with modes
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. Also tells whether the update check happens before authentication.

documented_claim: Setting AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true opts out of auto-updates.
observed_method: observe: same pre-login run with the env var set; expect no manifest/storage.googleapis.com connections and no updater/ writes
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes.

documented_claim: enableTelemetry (default true) permits metric collection and crash-log streaming; anonymous usage statistics and crash reports.
observed_method: observe: pre-login startup with default settings; list every CONNECT host and classify (model / telemetry / update / auth / unknown)
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial: shows whether telemetry is sent before sign-in; post-login telemetry needs an account. No telemetry host is documented.

documented_claim: enableTelemetry=false stops metric and crash-log collection.
observed_method: observe: repeat the pre-login run with {"enableTelemetry": false} in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json and diff the host list
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial.

documented_claim: Interactions are collected 'only when you have the Service running'.
observed_method: observe: after `agy` exits, check for surviving processes (updater, language server) and any connections in the following 15 min
notes: surface=CLI (claim is product-wide Terms); pre_login_checkable=yes for the CLI process-lifetime part.

documented_claim: With modelProvider=gemini and GEMINI_API_KEY, model requests go directly to the Gemini API and the CLI never establishes an account session.
observed_method: observe (optional, author decision): pre-login run with a deliberately invalid dummy key; record whether only the Gemini API host is contacted and whether any Google sign-in/account host is contacted
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial: an invalid key returns an API error, which is normal client traffic; no quota is used. Skip if the author considers it outside A16.

documented_claim: Session tokens are stored in the OS keyring (Linux Secret Service over D-Bus); /logout purges saved profiles from the keyring.
observed_method: observe: needs a completed sign-in; N/A (no access). Pre-login part: run with and without a D-Bus session bus and capture the storage-backend message on stderr
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial. Token write itself needs a login.

documented_claim: Without a D-Bus session bus (headless hosts, containers) the CLI bypasses the keyring and uses file storage; issue #479 names ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token.
observed_method: observe: in a container without D-Bus, record the stderr backend message and any file created at that path pre-login (mode bits); token content never read
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial. Docs (cli/install) mention only the keyring, so a file fallback is a docs-vs-changelog gap.

documented_claim: The CLI ignores GOOGLE_API_KEY and does not load .env files; GEMINI_API_KEY alone has no effect without modelProvider=gemini.
observed_method: observe: synthetic repo with .env containing a canary GEMINI_API_KEY and settings modelProvider=gemini but no env var; expect startup error 'GEMINI_API_KEY is not set' (no network request with the canary)
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. Canary is synthetic (A16, §8.3).

documented_claim: MCP OAuth tokens are stored at ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_oauth_tokens.json.
observed_method: observe: needs an MCP OAuth flow inside a session; N/A (no access)
notes: surface=CLI+app+IDE; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here). Issue #815 (third-party) reports 0644 copies in four dirs.

documented_claim: settings.json and history.jsonl are created 0600; mcp_oauth_tokens.json is created 0644 (third-party, agy 1.1.14 macOS).
observed_method: observe: stat every file and dir created under ~/.gemini and ~/.cache/antigravity during install and pre-login runs (umask 022)
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial: only files created before sign-in.

documented_claim: install.sh stages the payload in ~/.cache/antigravity/staging and removes it on exit (trap cleanup), installing only ~/.local/bin/agy.
observed_method: observe: filesystem diff before/after install
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. Embedded ripgrep is later extracted to ~/.cache/antigravity/bin/ (issue #1029).

documented_claim: In a non-interactive environment, an unauthenticated headless run exits with an 'authentication required' error instead of hanging.
observed_method: observe: `agy -p hi </dev/null` in a container with no credentials, no TTY; record exit code, stderr, duration and hosts
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. Core pre-login probe.

documented_claim: Read-only print-mode answers (-p "/help", "/config", "/permissions", "/hooks", "/changelog") run without an agent turn or quota.
observed_method: observe: run each pre-login; record whether they work without auth and what /config and /permissions print for the default settings
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. If /permissions works pre-login it shows the effective default rules without a model.

documented_claim: toolPermission defaults to request-review; workspace reads/writes auto-allowed; command, read_url, execute_url, mcp and non-workspace files default to Ask; headless soft-denies tools needing approval and exits 0.
observed_method: bench: needs a model turn; N/A (no access: Google login or API key)
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here). If pre-login `-p /permissions` works, the static part is checkable (see previous row).

documented_claim: --dangerously-skip-permissions auto-approves all tool requests, including requests to bypass the terminal sandbox.
observed_method: bench: needs a model turn; N/A (no access)
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here). Sandbox-bypass part is a vendor reply on issue #36 (by design).

documented_claim: App on macOS/Linux defaults to the 'Default' preset: commands run without prompting inside the sandbox; outside it they ask.
observed_method: N/A (no access: desktop app needs GUI and Google login)
notes: surface=app (not the IDE); pre_login_checkable=no.

documented_claim: IDE terminal auto execution offers Request Review and Always Proceed; strict mode forces Request Review and ignores the terminal allowlist.
observed_method: N/A (no access)
notes: pre_login_checkable=no; IDE not installed and needs GUI + Google login: N/A (no access). Launch IDE (Nov 2025) defaulted to 'Auto' per PromptArmor and Embrace The Red.

documented_claim: On first launch the CLI asks the user to confirm trust of the repository directory.
observed_method: observe: interactive pty run in a fresh synthetic repo; record prompt order (sign-in vs trust) from the TUI output
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=partial: reachable only if the trust step is shown before sign-in.

documented_claim: Workspace hooks in .agents/hooks.json load after the folder is trusted (implied by the 1.1.1 fix).
observed_method: observe: synthetic repo with a SessionStart hook that touches a canary file in /tmp; run `agy -p hi` (no TTY, unauthenticated) and a pty `agy` that stops at the first prompt; check canary
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes. Docs/hooks has no trust statement; a canary written before trust or sign-in = finding.

documented_claim: Docs do not say whether stdio servers in .agents/mcp_config.json start before workspace trust; unconfigured MCP tool calls default to Ask.
observed_method: observe: synthetic repo with a stdio MCP server whose command writes a canary file; process watch during pre-login runs; any spawn before trust = finding
notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=yes for spawn-before-trust; tool-call approval needs a model turn.

documented_claim: Rule files in .agents/rules/ without valid `trigger` front matter are silently discarded; AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md are always on for their directory.
observed_method: bench: needs a model turn; N/A (no access). Static parse by harnesswatch audit instructions only
notes: surface=CLI+app+IDE; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here).

observed_method: N/A (no access: app)

notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here). Issues #1160 (WSL2 seccomp EBUSY) and #1204 (AppArmor userns) suggest the sandbox may fail to start in some hosts.

documented_claim: IDE sandbox uses nsjail on Linux and Seatbelt on macOS, is off by default, and strict mode turns it on with network denied.
observed_method: N/A (no access)

notes: surface=CLI; pre_login_checkable=no (needs a model turn; no Google login or API key here).
